title: Virtual Care Cancellation Timing, No-Show Status and Fee Waivers
content:
A patient cancellation of a scheduled Virtual Care visit is timely when made at least the visit type's cancellation notice hours, counted in full elapsed hours, before the start, and late otherwise. This policy sets how a cancellation is classed, when a scheduled visit becomes a no-show, which fee applies, and when a fee is waived or removed.

## Policy clauses

1. **Timely and late.** A patient cancellation of a scheduled virtual visit is timely when made at least the visit type's cancellation notice hours of full elapsed hours before the start, and late otherwise.
2. **No-fee cancellations.** A clinic cancellation is clinic-initiated, and an on-demand request released after the visit type's queue maximum wait is a queue timeout; neither carries a fee.
3. **Fees.** A late cancellation is charged the visit type's late cancellation fee and a no-show the visit type's no-show fee, where those are above $0.00.
4. **No-show status.** A scheduled visit becomes a no-show when the patient has not joined by the end of the visit type's join grace period after the start. A virtual no-show fee is charged only when the encounter's status is no-show; that status is read from the system's record of the encounter before the fee is assessed.
5. **First-offense waiver.** Where the visit type's first-no-show setting is Yes and the patient has no other virtual no-show in the look-back window, the no-show fee is waived at assessment with the reason first offense. The look-back window is the rolling 12 calendar months ending on the scheduled date of the missed visit, excluding that visit; it counts the patient's other Virtual Care encounters with status no-show whose scheduled date falls inside it.
6. **Medicaid Managed Care Account.** A patient whose Patient Financial Account is on the Medicaid Managed Care Account tier on the encounter date is never charged a virtual fee (reason Medicaid prohibition), which takes precedence over the first-offense waiver.
7. **Removal of a charged fee.** A charged fee is removed on documented clinic error or a technical failure on the group's side, with the reason clinic error or technical failure. A removal after the fee was charged is posted as an adjustment on the Patient Financial Account.

## Timeliness at the boundary (hypothetical visits)

Full elapsed hours count only complete hours; a part-hour does not count.

| Hypothetical notice | Scheduled start | Cancellation made at | Full elapsed hours before the start | Class |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4 hours | 15:00 | 11:00 the same day | 4 | Timely |
| 4 hours | 15:00 | 11:30 the same day | 3 | Late |
| 24 hours | Tuesday 10:00 | Monday 10:00 | 24 | Timely |
| 24 hours | Tuesday 10:00 | Monday 10:20 | 23 | Late |

## The no-show fee decision (visit type with a no-show fee above $0.00, encounter status no-show)

| Medicaid Managed Care Account tier on the encounter date | First-no-show setting | Other no-shows in the look-back window | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes or No | Any number | Not charged; reason Medicaid prohibition |
| No | Yes | 0 | Waived at assessment; reason first offense |
| No | Yes | 1 or more | Charged |
| No | No | Any number | Charged |

A charged fee in any row is removed on documented clinic error or a technical failure on the group's side.

## Status of a cancelled or missed encounter

- A request is cancelled when the patient cancels it or it is abandoned in the queue before a clinician picks it up.
- A scheduled visit is cancelled when the patient or the clinic cancels it before it starts.
- A scheduled visit becomes a no-show when the patient does not join within the join grace period.

## Example (hypothetical join grace period of 10 minutes)

A visit scheduled for 14:00 whose patient has not joined by 14:10 becomes a no-show. If the patient's account is not on the Medicaid Managed Care Account tier on that date, the visit type's first-no-show setting is Yes, and the patient's only other Virtual Care no-show had a scheduled date 18 months earlier, the look-back window holds no other no-show and the fee is waived at assessment with the reason first offense.
